explanation: On S₄, u=0 and v decreases from 1 to 0. Hence y=1-v and x=2y(1-y)=1/2-2(y-1/2)². This is a left-opening parabola traversed from (0,0) to (0,1), confirming the worked solution.

answers.correct_value: An arc of a left-opening parabola, traversed from $(0,0)$ to $(0,1).$
answers.wrong_value: An arc of a left-opening parabola, traversed from $(0,1)$ to $(0,0).$
